tagline: Kuribayashi数码单反相机，1959 年发布
description: Kuribayashi于1959年推出的数码单反相机。

specs.英文简介: The Petri Penta is the first of a series of 35mm SLR cameras made in the late 1950s and early '60s by Kuribayashi/Petri (the company changed its legal name to Petri in 1962, while this series of cameras was current; they all bear the name Petri on the front of the prism).
